sentences.en: In the drought, many people and animals starved to death.
sentences.zh: 在旱灾期间，许多人和动物因饥饿而死亡。

sentences.en: The unprecedented drought did severe damage to the wheat harvest.
sentences.zh: 前所未有的干旱对小麦收成造成了严重破坏。

sentences.en: The spell of drought did severe damage to the harvest.
sentences.zh: 旱季导致收成遭受了严重的损失。

senses.zh: 长期缺乏，严重短缺；<古>口渴；干旱，旱灾
